raw.explanation: Norethindrone acetate is a progesterone receptor (PGR) agonist, and its selective antiproliferative/killing pattern is best explained by PGR expression: lines that express PGR (e.g., endometrial, breast, some melanoma/colorectal lines) are sensitized, while PGR-negative lines (most lung, mesothelioma, and many gastrointestinal lines) are protected. The virtual-cell signature showing downregulation of MYC, PCNA, CDC45, CDK1, and LIG1 is consistent with progestin/PGR-mediated cell-cycle arrest, and the transcriptional similarity to estradiol/aromatase inhibitors supports a hormone-receptor-dependent mechanism. TP53 mutation is common across both sensitive and resistant lines and is therefore not a strong discriminator, whereas PGR expression and possibly PTEN loss (which can amplify PI3K/AKT-dependent proliferation that PGR signaling opposes) are more plausible predictors.
